Description: The system must require passwords to contain at least 12 characters with uppercase, lowercase, numbers, and special characters.
Check: Verify the 'minlen' setting in /etc/security/pwquality.conf is 12 or greater. Run: grep minlen /etc/security/pwquality.conf. If the value is less than 12 or is commented out, this is a finding.
Fix: Configure the system to require a minimum password length of 12 characters. Add or edit the following line in /etc/security/pwquality.conf: minlen = 12
Rationale: Longer passwords increase the time and computational resources required to compromise the password via brute force.
Code:
control 'SV-123456' do
  impact 0.7
  describe file('/etc/security/pwquality.conf') do
    its('content') { should match /^minlen\s*=\s*(1[2-9]|[2-9][0-9])/ }
  end
end

Description: All successful and failed authentication attempts must be logged.
